name: wired-future
description: Agent-native 3D creative canvas. Human and AI agent share one screen via WebMCP.

scripts.build: cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-build next build && npm run export:copy
scripts.build:local: cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-build NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH= next build && npm run export:copy
scripts.export:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('.next-build','out',{recursive:true});if(!fs.existsSync('out/index.html'))throw new Error('export missing index.html');console.log('exported -> out/')"
